title: Design System: ARCIL Split-Flap Operations Wall

display.purpose: Central masthead title and live operational identity.

brand.purpose: Large left-aligned brand mark in the operations header.

data.purpose: Queue, agenda, agent, stream, and ledger data.

label.purpose: Compact uppercase section and column headings.

shadows.name: header-cabinet-lift
shadows.purpose: Subtle physical presence for the top equipment band.

motion.name: agenda-hover
motion.purpose: Quiet row targeting in the central agenda.

components.name: Operations Header
components.description: Three-zone top band for brand, title, live clock, and live connection state.
components.css: .ds-header { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; min-height: 76px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid #36383a; background: linear-gradient(90deg,#1a1b1d,#111214 47%,#1a1b1d); box-shadow: inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.06),0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,.2); color: #f0ede4; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; } .ds-header strong, .ds-header h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-header h1 { font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: .16em; } .ds-header > span { justify-self: end; display: flex; gap: 22px; align-items: center; } .ds-header time { font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-header b { display: flex; gap: 9px; align-items: center; color: #4ea7ff; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-header i { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #4ea7ff; box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(78,167,255,.6); }

components.name: Queue Row
components.description: Open-queue label and severity-marked count in the left rail.
components.css: .ds-queue { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 35px; padding: 0 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); background: #151618; color: #c9c9c4; font: 600 11px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-queue b { color: #ffc14c; }

components.name: Agent Row
components.description: Availability-marked agent record in the permanently open agents rail.
components.css: .ds-agent { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 10px minmax(0,1fr); gap: 8px; align-items: start; padding: 8px 5px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); background: #151618; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; } .ds-agent i { width: 7px; height: 7px; margin-top: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: #62d49a; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(98,212,154,.6); } .ds-agent b, .ds-agent small { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-agent b { color: #dddcd5; font-size: 12px; } .ds-agent small { margin-top: 3px; color: #81817c; font-size: 10px; }

components.name: Agenda Board Row
components.description: Five-column operational record with fixed scanning order and state-colored values.
components.html: COBRANÇASR$ 18.400FINANCEIRO2 follow-ups aguardandoTRATAR FILA PENDENTE
components.css: .ds-agenda { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 1.35fr .8fr 1.55fr 1.35fr; align-items: center; min-height: 47px; padding: 0 13px; border-bottom: 1px solid #414244; background: #202123; color: #b7c9db; font: 600 11px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .025em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background .18s ease; } .ds-agenda:hover { background: #292a2d; } .ds-agenda > * { min-width: 0; padding: 0 10px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); } .ds-agenda > *:last-child { border: 0; } .ds-agenda strong { padding-left: 0; color: #e8e5db; } .ds-agenda .ds-state, .ds-agenda .ds-action { color: #ffc14c; }

components.name: Event Stream Row
components.description: Three-column chronological event entry that keeps provenance and event visible together.
components.css: .ds-event { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 56px 63px minmax(0,1fr); gap: 8px; align-items: center; min-height: 37px; padding: 0 13px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); background: #151618; color: #ffc14c; font: 10px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; } .ds-event time { color: #c7c5bb; } .ds-event span { text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-event b { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Footer Ledger Cell
components.description: Always-open summary cell that closes the wall with a factual operational total or state.
components.css: .ds-ledger { min-height: 90px; padding: 16px 18px; border-right: 1px solid #383a3c; background: #17181a; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-ledger span, .ds-ledger b { display: block; } .ds-ledger span { color: #a09f98; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-ledger b { margin-top: 13px; color: #62aaff; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: .04em; }

narrative.overview: ARCIL is a dark, all-open operational board built to be read like a split-flap departures wall: firm divisions, monospaced signals, and a fixed scan order. It makes the entire operating picture visible at once—open queues, current agenda, agents, event stream, and ledger—rather than asking the owner to navigate through a dashboard hierarchy. The surface is deliberately utilitarian. Charcoal and graphite form a single equipment-like field; ivory characters and colored state values provide the information hierarchy. Color is factual state marking, while borders, columns, and uppercase labels do the structural work.
keyCharacteristics: Everything operational remains simultaneously visible in a three-panel wall and bottom ledger.
IBM Plex Mono owns the wall’s voice: timing, labels, values, and table-like scan rhythm.
Hairline metal dividers create slots, columns, and ledger cells instead of soft card depth.
Blue is live/default state; amber, red, green, violet, and cyan encode real operational distinctions.

rules.name: The State-Only Color Rule
rules.body: A colored value must identify a live system state, domain, or severity. Structure stays neutral; do not introduce color fields, colored cards, or decorative gradient surfaces.

dos: Do keep queues, agent state, agenda, events, and ledger visible in the same operational frame.
Do preserve the fixed table columns, compact row heights, and monospaced scan rhythm.
Do use colored values for factual domain, connection, health, and severity state.
Do expose long mobile agenda data through intentional horizontal scroll rather than removing columns.
Do pair the live dot and all other color signals with readable text or a count.
donts: Don't replace the wall with cards, tabs, accordions, or a feed that hides part of the operation.
Don't round, soften, or elevate the board into a consumer dashboard aesthetic.
Don't use gradients beyond the restrained header band or use glow as a general decoration.
Don't add unverified severity to events; only queue severity and supplied type/state determine their treatment.
Don't wrap dense board-cell text into tall rows; truncate inside the existing scan grid.
